author: BartucsCutThroat
body:
Ideally save enough orns for your t10 class.  Picking up the t8 and t9 warrior classes would be a good idea for divine bastion 1 and 2. Also I believe the deity line has deific channel as well.  Orns will be easier when you hit t10 and then you can go back and buy up different classes for skills.

Save your shards for your t10 celestial and then a celestial weapon.  That should make grinding tower shards easier.

author: knite_r
body:
1) I can't really think of anything specific to do with extra orns so you can do whatever you want with them as long as you keep the 21m (iirc) for gsummoner.
2) to push to 225 I would farm new lyonesse (snow place). I got to 225 before astral tree and it was more painful bit now I suggest to do the first two astral seed quests every day, then with 4 seeds get movement speed, XP boost, or and gold boost. Also you want to make sure to be farming dragon roost as much as possible for red Dragonite to Master/Demon/God forge 2 standard quality questing staffs (that you will quickly get through the dungeon from Glatisant). You also want to farm hardened steel for God forging a low quality Mighty Mimic head (broken preferably). Last thing in terms of equipment I'd look for 2 ornate cursed monster tomes (replaced by band of gods once you eventually get it). Last suggestion I can give you is to make sure that you get summon buggane once Halloween comes back around since it's going to stay relevant pretty much till lvl 250 possibly even after.
